name: goal-owner
description: A bounded, resumable Project Owner for goals you choose to run autonomously.
author: kirocrew
highlights: One durable record per user-owned goal
Pause and resume without losing progress
useCases: Run a goal through bounded owner cycles while retaining human control over scope, budgets, and completion evidence.
configuration: Enable Goal Owner, create a goal with its definition of done, then inspect or pause it from the Goal Owner page.
